newsitem.title: USA: KazMinCo acquires new mining licence.
newsitem.headline: KazMinCo acquires new mining licence.

text.p: Kazakhstan Minerals Corp said it has finalised the acquisition of a licence to explore and develop the Satpayevskoye metals property, located near its Shokai licence where a porphyry copper system has been discovered.
The licence for Satpayevskoye covers gold, copper and polymetallics and is for a five-year exploration period and 20-year mining period, KazMinCo said in a statement.
KazMinCo will be project manager in the joint stock company Satpayevskoye to carry out work at eponymous property.

Meawhile at KazMinCo's Shokai licence acquired earlier this year, the company said an intensive program of scout drilling and mapping has led to the discovery of the North Shokai porphyry copper system.
Drilling at Shokai continues to determine the extent of the property, KazMinCo said.
